g.title: b2_recipes
g.text: B-2's three fine-tuning recipes, side by side
green: trains · grey: frozen, or a fixed pass · amber: where the PDM labels come from · every recipe starts at R-tilde exactly, keeps its last epoch, and reads train rows only

g.title: j1
g.text: each step: a batch of 64 train rows
4 passes from cached tokens, the read on every pass
→ the 32 proposals p₄ and the scorer's 32 scores

g.title: j2
g.text: the vendored PDM scorer on CPU workers,
+ the auxiliaries' targets (collision, TTC agents; area)

g.title: j3
g.text: 1 × planning loss (L1 to the human + 0.5 × teachers)
1 × final-score BCE against the PDM label
1 × agents' presence BCE + 0.1 × their corners' L1
2 × drivable-area BCE · sub-scores at 0, as released

g.title: j4
g.text: auxiliary heads frozen: their losses shape the features

g.title: common
g.text: every arm (C, O, D, HD, H6, H3) starts at R-tilde exactly: the read's output layer at zero, LoRA's B at zero, full copies of the release · the last epoch is kept: nothing chosen
train rows only (94,195), never a report row · the preflight first: the untrained model equals R-tilde bit for bit, slots recomputed live equal the stored ones, the fold rule,
the teachers equal their files, PDM labels re-score exactly ·
they differ in steps, parameters, labels and auxiliaries

g.title: l2
g.text: every row's p₄ (32 × 8 × 3) and q₃ for stage 3
vendored PDM labels, 32 × 9, on train, select,
R-clean and navtest · about 10–15 min of CPU

g.title: l3
g.text: passes 1–3 frozen: p₄ and its labels fixed
a pass-4-only copy of the read · 1e-4

g.title: l4
g.text: picks exactly as stage 1's refiner with the release's scorer

g.title: f1
g.text: the refiner (2.32 M), initial queries and ego encoder (0.07 M) · 2e-5

g.title: f3
g.text: + a pass-4-only copy of the read · 1e-4

g.title: f4
g.text: the first pass's full refiner brought the release's pick
0.28–0.36 m closer to the human on nuScenes (
the largest gain, and the most room to drift
